seoTitle: How to Copy Subtasks Between Tasks in Asana
metaDescription: Learn how to copy or duplicate subtask checklists from one Asana task to another in 2026 using bulk selection and duplication tools, no retyping needed.
intro: Rebuilding the same subtask checklist by hand across multiple tasks wastes time, and Asana offers a few ways to move or duplicate that structure instead. This guide covers selecting subtasks in bulk, copying them into a new parent task, and using duplication settings to clone an entire task with its nested subtasks.

steps.heading: Open the source task's subtask list
steps.body: Expand the parent task to view its complete internal subtask checklist before copying anything.

steps.heading: Bulk-select the subtasks
steps.body: Use multi-select keyboard shortcuts to highlight multiple subtask lines at once instead of copying them one at a time.

steps.heading: Understand what carries over
steps.body: Copying subtask text strings brings over the task names, but confirm which metadata, like assignees or descriptions, transfers with them.

steps.heading: Paste into the target task
steps.body: Open the target task's subtask field, position your cursor, and paste the list to generate matching subtask rows instantly.

steps.heading: Reassign or duplicate the whole structure
steps.body: Use the project dropdown re-assign method for individual subtasks, or use task duplication settings to clone an entire parent task along with its nested subtasks.

faq.question: Do assignees carry over when I copy subtasks?
faq.answer: Some metadata transfers depending on the method used, so it's worth checking each pasted subtask to confirm assignees and due dates copied correctly.

faq.question: Can I copy subtasks between different projects?
faq.answer: Yes, subtasks can be pasted into a task in a different project, though you may need to re-link them to the new project's context.

faq.question: Is there a faster way to duplicate an entire checklist?
faq.answer: Using the task duplication setting clones the whole parent task including its nested subtasks in one action, rather than copying subtasks individually.

faq.question: Will comments and attachments move with copied subtasks?
faq.answer: Comments and attachments are generally tied to the original subtask, so a straight copy-paste of text may not bring those over automatically.
